bg.purpose: Page ground (light). The header uses it at 80% with a 12px blur.

bg-soft.purpose: Product still sidebar; selected segmented tab and filter chip fill.

line.purpose: Hairline borders and dividers: cards, log, tabs, pills, header and footer rules.

fg.purpose: Text and headings; current nav link; hover state for links.

fg-muted.purpose: Secondary text, nav and footer links, card notes, log times and titles.

accent.purpose: Focus outline on every interactive element. Also the home activity dot and the /bot report link (the two other uses).

ok.purpose: Board status dot and Working pill (globals.css --ok). Dark mode: #3cc28a.

warn.purpose: Board status dot for Paused and feed warnings (globals.css --warn). Dark mode: #e3a53a.

idle.purpose: Board status dot for Idle (globals.css --idle). Dark mode: #5d5d66.

display.purpose: Home headline only. clamp(40px, 6vw, 64px), weight 600, line-height 1.04, -0.035em.

small.purpose: Header and footer text, feature text (14px).

button.purpose: Button labels (15px; header account button 14px), weight 500.

wordmark.purpose: Kentcrosswise wordmark in the header and footer (16px, 600, -0.02em).

mono.purpose: Geist Mono for timestamps and product still labels (12px), and literal code such as the /bot User-Agent. The build uppercases some card labels; that treatment is not canonized.

mono-label.purpose: Card labels at 11px, 0.06em (product still). Uppercase is not canonized; not for use as a kicker or eyebrow.

reading-title.purpose: Essay title and /bot title: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 2.75rem) (32 to 44px), Geist 600, line-height 1.08, -0.03em, balanced wrapping.

reading-body.purpose: Essay article body only: Newsreader (--font-reading) 400, 21px, line-height 1.65; 19px under 640px. Paragraphs 1.1em apart. Not for headings, controls or /bot.

shadows.name: product-still-frame
shadows.purpose: Home product still frame only. The same value applies in dark mode. The only shadow in the system.

motion.name: hover
motion.purpose: Hover and selected-state changes on buttons, links, tabs and chips. Off under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: enter
motion.value: rise: opacity 0 to 1, translateY(6px) to 0, 300ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1) both
motion.purpose: Hero and product still, once on load. Off under prefers-reduced-motion. Nothing loops.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Max-width rules: phone gutters, sidebar hidden, cards and log stacked, header on two rows.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Min-width rules: footer note and links share rows; product still and feature grid at desktop layout.

breakpoints.name: board-container
breakpoints.purpose: Board container width: one column for agent cards below 720px, four seat tiles at or above.

components.name: Rating Pill
components.description: Essay rating: Overall 1 to 5 and the What worked tags. Each pill is a label around a visually hidden native radio or checkbox, so the keyboard and screen reader behaviour is the native one. 44px tall, 44px minimum width, pill radius. narrative.overview:
Paper is the visual system for the public pages. It is plain and calm. A white page holds black type. One blue accent marks focus. Hairline borders separate content, and shadows are used once. Text is set in Geist, with Geist Mono for timestamps and labels. The essay body is set in Newsreader. Dark mode follows the operating system setting. The page has no control for it.

The home page, the shared header and the shared footer use Paper. /office uses Paper on both tabs: the Board tab and the Room tab (see Room Card). /demo uses the Paper app frame (see the Demo App Frame component). /bot and the owner essay reader use Paper with a 680px reading column (see Reading Column). Other pages are not covered yet.
keyCharacteristics: Plain and calm: a white page, black type, no decoration.
One blue accent, used for focus (and the home activity dot).
Hairline borders separate content; one shadow, on the home product still.
Geist for text; Geist Mono for timestamps and labels only; Newsreader for the essay body only.
Automatic dark mode from prefers-color-scheme; no toggle.
Short motion: 150ms hover, 300ms enter, plays once, nothing loops.

rules.name: The Focus-Only Accent Rule
rules.body: Accent is for focus. Do not add it to new elements. The activity dot is the one existing exception.

rules.name: The Room Paper Rule
rules.body: The Room tab uses Paper tokens only. Its role dots take their colour from the drawing and are the one literal-colour exception.

rules.name: The Geist Mono Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is for timestamps, labels and literal code such as the /bot User-Agent. Hierarchy comes from size and weight; there is no third weight.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separate content with 1px --line borders. Shadows do not separate content.

rules.name: The Single Shadow Rule
rules.body: The product still frame is the only shadow in the system. Do not add shadows to other components.

rules.name: The One Primary Rule
rules.body: Keep one primary button in each view.

rules.name: The Reading Font Rule
rules.body: Newsreader is for the essay body only. Headings, controls and /bot stay in Geist.

rules.name: The Replay Plays Once Rule
rules.body: The room's replay plays once and stops at its end. Play starts it again. Nothing loops.

dos: **Do** read colours, radii and motion from the tokens in `globals.css`.
**Do** keep one primary button in each view.
**Do** keep motion to 150ms hover and 300ms enter, and turn it off under reduced motion.
**Do** keep the simulated-data note in the footer.
**Do** use a 4px grid for new spacing.
donts: **Don't** add shadows except to the product still.
**Don't** use accent for anything but focus. Two exceptions exist: the activity dot, and the /bot report link.
**Don't** add looping or ambient animation, parallax or scroll effects.
**Don't** use PT Serif on new pages.
**Don't** put literal colours in new components.
**Don't** use Newsreader outside the essay body.
